column2: 'A Settings window with a searchable sidebar, back and forward history and section anchors.'
'A crowded system tray can hide it; drag it out of the overflow (^).'
'A format after a colon picks how they look, like {{date:yyyy-MM-dd}}, or use the date/time button above. A -tz(...) part sets the timezone, like {{date-tz(America/New_York):yyyy-MM-dd}}.'
'A format after a colon picks how they look, like {{date:yyyy-MM-dd}}. A -tz(...) part sets the timezone, like {{date-tz(America/New_York):yyyy-MM-dd}}.'
'A red mic indicator shows that Mic Mute is on. It does not guarantee that all apps stop capturing audio.'
'A running session appears in the island with the time it has left, or ∞ when it has no end.'
'A tabbed tray panel with Keep awake, Volume mixer, System, Network, Disks, Power, Utilities, Controls, Quick toggles and Wallpaper tabs.'
'Add it to the Start menu and keep it if you delete the download. No administrator password needed.'
'Allow calendar access in Windows Settings to see your appointments.'
'Appearance can follow Windows or be forced to light or dark.'
'Apps that have not opened a window stay open. Notification-area apps stay open unless you explicitly allow them to quit.'
'Blocked: Media Player, Groove Music, Windows Media Player and iTunes.'
'Blocks the music app opening after a detected media key. Headphone commands without a detected key are left alone.'
'Build and tooling leftovers that are rebuilt on demand.'
'CPU, GPU and battery usage, memory pressure and network speed in real time.'
'Camera access for WinKnife is turned off in Settings.'
'Central keyboard shortcuts page with conflict reporting.'
'Choose where calls and chat apps play'
'Claude app not found on this PC'
'Claude checks your limits only while its icon is in the notification area (system tray). Turn the icon on in the Claude app settings, and your limits appear here within minutes.'
'Cleans only the safe part on its own at the chosen time. Items that must not be lost go to the Recycle Bin.'
'Click a chip to start. Click it again to stop'
'Click an active app’s taskbar icon to rotate through its windows, like Alt+`.'
'Click it to open the panel. If you do not see it, click the ^ arrow to show hidden icons.'
'Click the WinKnife icon next to the clock for the panel; right-click it for the menu.'
'Click to see it react. Rest the pointer on it to pet it. Left alone, it dozes off until you come back.'
'Close an app’s last window (Ctrl+W, Alt+F4 or the × button).'
'Closes an app when its last window closes'
'Does all of the above, then removes the preferences and the app data folder, leaving nothing behind. The app quits when done. Delete the app folder afterwards to finish. You can reinstall anytime.'
'Downloads could not be scanned. Check Controlled folder access in Windows Security.'
'Downloads the public price list from the WinKnife project once a day, so new models get an API value without an app update. Nothing about your usage is sent.'
'Dragging right brings the desktop on the left, the way a touchpad swipe carries it along with your fingers.'
'Drop files on the screen edge to hold them'

'Each source below is shown as it reads right now, so you can check it against Claude (Settings > Usage) and the Codex app. The newest reading is the one WinKnife shows; a source is never mixed with another. Reset times appear only when a source reports one.'
'Enabled in WinKnife. It starts working as soon as Windows Snap is off.'
'Every screen now follows the same look: cards, switches and the segmented tab bar.'
'Every utility is hidden. Click the pencil to show some again, or add more features.'
'Get notified when Claude asks for permission'
'Global shortcut: Quit all apps except the front one'
'Hide this card. “Review introduction” in About brings the tour back.'
'Hides the matching Windows switcher shortcuts only while WinKnife’s switcher is active. All running apps stay reachable.'
'High-DPI captures are saved at their logical size, which makes smaller files.'
'Hold Alt to temporarily use the other mode.'
'Hold the chosen button and drag: left or right moves one desktop over, up opens Task View, down shows the desktop. A short click still does what it always did.'
'Hold the shortcut, move the pointer toward an edge or corner, then release to place the active window.'
'Hover over an open app in the taskbar to preview and peek at its windows.'
'In taskbar preview, × closes every window of the app instead of only that window.'
'In text fields (like when renaming), Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V keep working as usual.'
'It sits next to the clock; click it for the panel, right-click it for the menu. If it is hidden, click the ^ arrow first.'
'Its normal function is turned off while the super key is on.'
'Keeps a forgotten session from draining the laptop battery.'
'Latest sample is too old or has no running window'
'Limited: running without administrator rights. Windows that run as administrator ignore WinKnife until it is elevated too.'
'Listens to the player’s own audio output to move the bars. Nothing is stored or sent. Without it, the bars keep their usual motion.'
'Lists windows from the current virtual desktop.'
'Move the new copy to the Recycle Bin'

'Name the folders to look in and the bar finds files by name as you type. Nothing is indexed and no permission is asked for: it uses Windows Search and offers only what you can already see in File Explorer.'
'No OCR language pack is installed. Add one in Settings > Time & language > Language & region > Add a language > Optical character recognition.'
'No name, account, email, device identifier, logs, screenshots, files or clipboard content are included. The text goes to GitHub only when you submit the issue draft in your browser.'
'No readings yet. Open the AI Agents page in the island, or press Read now.'
'No token_count event with limits in the logs'
'Not asked yet, or Codex could not answer'
'Not asked yet, or every window has since expired'
'Not granted. Windows asks (UAC) when something needs it.'
'Not used: an older reading than the one in use'
'Nothing is sent by WinKnife itself. Issues on GitHub are public, so do not include private information.'
'Nothing to show in {0} yet. Install a feature that belongs here, or hide this tab in Settings.'
'Notification-area apps stay open by default. Apps you select here can quit after their last window closes while they are in the taskbar. Exceptions still keep them open.'
'Notifications for WinKnife are off in Windows Settings, so alerts cannot appear.'
'Off: WinKnife relies on the automatic detection above.'
'Old iPhone and iPad backups take a big slice of the storage Windows counts as Other. Remove only the ones you no longer need; a new backup is made when you plug the device in again.'
'On: Claude Code reports permission requests to WinKnife.'
'Open the AI Agents settings, "Where these numbers come from", to compare every source.'
'Open the destination folder and press Ctrl+V to move them there.'
'Opens a quick window with search, pinned items and Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 shortcuts for pasting into the previous app.'
'Opens the Microsoft Store, where this update is installed'
'Opens the folder with WinKnife’s log file, to read or send along.'

'Optional. Overrides the default name using the same %y, %year, %mo, %month, %d, %h, %mi and %s tokens, plus %# for an auto-incrementing number (%## pads to 2 digits, %### to 3, and so on).'

'Pick a still wallpaper without opening Settings.'
'Pick one of the glyphs, or type the hex code of any Segoe Fluent Icons glyph in settings.json (menuBarIconSymbol).'
'Pin the icon to the taskbar corner'
'Play a sound when your PC locks and unlocks.'
'Precision touchpads only. Windows may also run its own four-finger gesture, set in Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Touchpad.'
'Press the Windows key and type “WinKnife” to open it.'
'Press the Windows key, type “WinKnife” and press Enter. This opens Settings if it is already running.'
'Press the new shortcut Escape cancels. Delete clears.'
'Programs that are part of Windows or made by Microsoft aren’t listed.'
'Protection observes only Alt+F4 and Ctrl+W (and their aliases) globally.'
'Protects Alt+F4 and Ctrl+W from accidental presses'
'Puts the pointer in the center of the next display.'
'Quit all leaves these apps running. File Explorer, WinKnife and Phone Link are always kept. You can still quit a kept app from its own row.'
'Reading banners works best when WinKnife is installed as an app.'
'Recommended: the tray icon is always there when you need it.'
'Removes the startup entry and the closed-lid rule WinKnife may have added. Useful to start fresh or before uninstalling. The app stays installed.'
'Reset since the last reading; waiting for a new one'
'Run WinKnife as administrator to use this in elevated apps.'
'Run as administrator for a more thorough scan.'
'Run as administrator to see apps using the network'
'S starts a search and pins the switcher open, so typing no longer fires Alt shortcuts, and a search starting with Q or W no longer closes the window or quits the app by mistake.'
'Saved copy has no window that is still running'
'Scans for leftovers from uninstalled apps, caches, logs and the Recycle Bin. You review everything first and removed items go to the Recycle Bin or are deleted as described in the list.'
'Search, install and remove apps with winget.'
'See an app’s windows from its taskbar button, and choose what a click on it does.'
'Select items in File Explorer and press Ctrl+X to cut them.'
'Shelf and Command Bar windows keep their real size when they open.'
'Shows a shortened preview of your last copy next to the tray icons. Click it to open the history.'
'Shows the charge in red at or below this level while on battery.'

'Shows “Claude needs your permission - project: tool” on the island, and an amber “Waiting for you” state in the Now card and the closed island. Applies to Claude Code (terminal and Claude app) and Codex.'
'Smart App Control is in evaluation mode. It may slow the first start.'
'Smart App Control is on. It may slow the first start or block unsigned parts of WinKnife; WinKnife explains it if that happens.'
'Some entries could not be removed. Try again.'
'Some features need WinKnife to run as administrator.'
'Some leftovers live in ProgramData, Program Files and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE and can only be removed by an administrator.'
'Some music apps require permission for their playback controls.'
'Some windows belong to apps running as administrator. Run WinKnife as administrator to control them.'
'Subagents working for this session right now'
'Switch to an English (US) layout while the bar is open'
'System caches such as Windows Update downloads, Prefetch and Windows\\Temp are only visible to an administrator. Nothing is changed until you review the list.'
'Tell me when an agent needs me'
'The Features hub: install only what you use, with bundles, permissions and a restart-to-unload card.'
'The cover and the playback buttons open this app. Automatic opens the music app that played last, then Spotify.'
'The entry under Startup apps disappears after you sign out and back in.'
'The first start can take a few seconds while Windows checks the files.'
'The icon returns by itself when metrics leave the tray and when there is something to signal (an update ready, “Keep awake” running or the microphone muted).'
'The login item is registered, but Windows still needs your approval. In Settings > Apps > Startup, allow WinKnife to start at sign-in.'
'The program files and shortcuts are being removed. Your settings were kept, so a later install picks up where you left off.'
'The program files, shortcuts and your settings are being removed.'
'The short introduction: bundles, start with Windows, where the icon is.'
'The shortcut only acts in File Explorer and leaves text fields alone. F2 works as a regular key; on laptops where it is a media key, use Fn-F2 or choose another shortcut.'
'The touchpad is untouched: it keeps its own scroll direction.'
'These items are in protected locations. Relaunch WinKnife as administrator to remove them.'
'This operation needs administrator approval. WinKnife does not capture passwords.'
'This shortcut is already taken by another app.'
'Transparency effects are on, so the panel’s transparency is set in Settings > Personalization > Colors.'
'Use Ctrl+X to cut and Ctrl+V to move files and folders in File Explorer, with a floating panel that shows what is cut.'
'Use at least Control, Alt or Windows with a key.'
'Uses each microphone’s mute control. Some apps may still hear you. This is not a privacy lock.'
'Uses each microphone’s mute or input-volume controls. Some apps may still hear you. This is not a privacy lock.'
'Uses window management APIs only to move and resize windows.'
'When File Explorer is active, Ctrl+V saves a copied image as a PNG in the current folder.'
'While any of these apps is open, even in the background, Super key pauses and the chosen key works normally.'
'While you drag a file, the shelf appears next to the tray icons. Whatever you drop is kept right there, in a button you shrink and open with a click that goes away once the shelf is empty.'
'WinKnife - a discreet tray utility for Windows'
'WinKnife can open the Microsoft Store page for App Installer, which provides winget. Install or update it there, then come back.'
'WinKnife cannot access Downloads. Allow it in Windows Security > Controlled folder access.'
'WinKnife can’t uninstall itself here. Use Settings › Advanced instead.'
'WinKnife is a set of small tools for your PC that lives in the tray, next to the clock. Everything is optional: on the next page you choose what to install.'
'WinKnife is running and looking after your PC.'
'WinKnife lives in the tray, so it is most useful when it is already there after you sign in.'
'WinKnife stays free and local, with no ads or usage tracking. If it helps you, a star on GitHub is the best way to help it grow.'
'WinKnife will remove its startup entry and preferences, then quit. This can’t be undone from the app.'
'WinKnife will stop starting with Windows and give back any power setting it changed. Your settings are kept.'
'Window layout on monitors with a different scale no longer overshoots the screen edge.'
'Windows Snap is using the same edges. Turn off “Snap windows” in Settings > System > Multitasking so WinKnife can take over.'
'Windows does not let apps pin themselves. Open Taskbar settings, expand “Other system tray icons” and switch WinKnife on.'
'Windows doesn’t allow apps to draw on the lock screen. WinKnife shows a greeting when you unlock instead.'
'Windows would not let WinKnife watch the keyboard. Restart WinKnife and switch this on again.'

'Without any change to Claude Code, WinKnife notices a tool call that has had no result for about 8 seconds while nothing is running for it and nothing is being written (20 seconds for web and MCP tools). That is shown as “probably a permission prompt”, because a slow tool looks the same. The hook below makes it exact and immediate.'
